sourceEnglishTitle: Hail Damage Inspection with an Adjuster
sourceEnglishObjective: Walk an adjuster across a hail-damaged roof, narrate the storm and findings, and agree on the scope
sourceEnglishSpeaking: You are the crew lead and the AI is the insurance adjuster: say when the storm came through, show the hits you marked, give counts and measurements clearly, and agree on the scope of work.

examples.es: La tormenta pasó el martes y el granizo cayó 15 minutos.
examples.en: The storm came through on Tuesday and the hail fell for 15 minutes.

examples.es: Contamos 12 golpes en el cuadro de prueba.
examples.en: We counted 12 hits in the test square.

example.target: La tormenta pasó el martes por la noche.
example.native: The storm came through Tuesday night.

example.target: El granizo cayó durante unos 15 minutos.
example.native: The hail fell for about 15 minutes.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite: caí, cayó, cayeron (i changes to y).

example.native: We counted 12 hits in this square.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite: conté, contó; contamos is the same in the present and the preterite.

example.target: Marcaron un cuadro de prueba de 10 por 10 pies.
example.native: They marked a test square of 10 by 10 feet.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite: marqué (c changes to qu), marcó, marcaron.

example.target: El lado oeste mide 1,200 pies cuadrados.
example.native: The west side measures 1,200 square feet.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Stem change e to i: mido, mide; preterite: medí, midió.

candidateObjective: 損害査定人に嵐の経過と屋根の損傷を説明し、工事範囲を確認する。
candidateFocus: ～により attributes damage to the storm. ～では and ～に対して compare roof faces; ～平方フィート preserves the source measurement unit.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 火曜日の夜に嵐が通りました。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The storm came through Tuesday night.

archivedForms.exampleJa: ひょうは約十五分間降りました。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The hail fell for about 15 minutes.

archivedForms.exampleJa: この区画では衝突痕を十二個数えました。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: We counted 12 hits in this square.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 十フィート四方の試験区画に印を付けました。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: They marked a test square of 10 by 10 feet.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 西側は千二百平方フィートあります。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The west side measures 1,200 square feet.

archivedSpeaking.opening: 火曜日の夜にひょうが降りました。西側の十フィート四方の区画では衝突痕を十二個数えました。雨どいを含む工事範囲を確認しましょう。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Walk an insurance adjuster through the observed hail marks. Give the storm time, test-square location, counts and measurements clearly, then discuss the proposed scope of work.

cards.reviewNote: Insurance adjuster has a specialized Japanese role/sense requiring locale review.
Impact mark/hail hit is an observed roof condition; confirm trade term.
Test square is a hail-assessment sampling area, not a generic experiment.
Insurance claim sense needs contextual Japanese term.
Granule loss on a shingle requires specific roofing terminology.

cards.sourceEnglish: the roof slope (one face of the roof)
cards.archivedEnglish: the roof slope (one face of the roof)
cards.reviewNote: Roof slope means one face of the roof, not merely any roof surface.
Scope of work needs insurance/contract sense.
Square foot is a unit; preserve numerical measurements.

cards.sourceSpanish: La tormenta pasó el martes por la noche.
cards.sourceEnglish: The storm came through Tuesday night.
cards.candidateJapanese: 火曜日の夜に嵐が通りました。
cards.archivedJapanese: 火曜日の夜に嵐が通りました。
cards.archivedEnglish: The storm came through Tuesday night.

cards.sourceEnglish: We counted 12 hits in this square.
cards.archivedJapanese: この区画では衝突痕を十二個数えました。
cards.archivedEnglish: We counted 12 hits in this square.
cards.reviewNote: Twelve hits in one test square is scene evidence, not a general threshold.

cards.archivedJapanese: ここではシングル材の表面粒が失われています。
cards.reviewNote: Granule-loss claim needs source and roofing review.

cards.archivedJapanese: 衝突痕を一つずつチョークで印してください。
cards.reviewNote: Marking hail impacts with chalk needs inspection/safety context.

cards.sourceEnglish: How many hits do you count?
cards.archivedJapanese: 衝突痕はいくつ数えましたか。
cards.archivedEnglish: How many hits do you count?
cards.reviewNote: Counted impacts depend on observation, not an automatic coverage decision.

cards.sourceEnglish: Can you repeat that more slowly?
cards.candidateJapanese: もう少しゆっくり繰り返していただけますか。
cards.archivedJapanese: もう少しゆっくり繰り返していただけますか。
cards.archivedEnglish: Can you repeat that more slowly?

cards.sourceEnglish: Do you agree with the scope?
cards.archivedJapanese: この工事範囲に同意しますか。
cards.archivedEnglish: Do you agree with the scope?
cards.reviewNote: Agreement on scope is not authorization or insurer coverage approval.

reader.sourceSpanish: La tormenta pasó el martes por la noche, y el granizo cayó durante unos 15 minutos.
reader.sourceEnglish: The storm came through Tuesday night, and the hail fell for about 15 minutes.
reader.candidateJapanese: 火曜日の夜に嵐が通り、ひょうは約十五分間降りました。
reader.archivedJapanese: 火曜日の夜に嵐が通り、ひょうは約十五分間降りました。
reader.archivedEnglish: The storm came through Tuesday night, and the hail fell for about 15 minutes.

reader.sourceSpanish: El jueves, el ajustador de la aseguradora llegó a las 10 para revisar el reclamo de la familia Ortiz.
reader.sourceEnglish: On Thursday, the insurance company's adjuster arrived at 10 to review the Ortiz family's claim.
reader.archivedJapanese: 木曜日の午前十時、保険会社の損害査定人がオルティス家の請求を確認しに来ました。
reader.archivedEnglish: On Thursday, the insurance company's adjuster arrived at 10 to review the Ortiz family's claim.
reader.reviewNote: Adjuster arrives to review the Ortiz family claim; insurance role and claim sense need review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio y Kevin subieron con él, con la cinta métrica y la tiza.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio and Kevin went up with him, with the tape measure and the chalk.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオとケビンは巻き尺とチョークを持って査定人と屋根に上がりました。
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio and Kevin went up with him, with the tape measure and the chalk.
reader.reviewNote: Roof access with the adjuster requires site-specific fall-protection review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Primero revisaron la canaleta y encontraron abolladuras en todo el lado oeste.
reader.sourceEnglish: First they checked the gutter and found dents along the whole west side.
reader.archivedJapanese: まず雨どいを確認すると、西側の全体にへこみがありました。
reader.archivedEnglish: First they checked the gutter and found dents along the whole west side.
reader.reviewNote: Dents along the gutter are observations, not proof of covered damage.

reader.sourceSpanish: En la cara del techo que da al oeste, marcaron un cuadro de prueba de 10 por 10 pies.
reader.sourceEnglish: On the roof slope that faces west, they marked a test square of 10 by 10 feet.
reader.archivedJapanese: 西向きの屋根面に、十フィート四方の試験区画を印しました。
reader.archivedEnglish: On the roof slope that faces west, they marked a test square of 10 by 10 feet.
reader.reviewNote: Ten-by-ten-foot test square and roof-slope measurement must remain exact.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Kevin, marca cada golpe con tiza, por favor.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Kevin, mark each hit with chalk, please.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「ケビン、衝突痕を一つずつチョークで印してください。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Kevin, mark each hit with chalk, please.
reader.reviewNote: Marking each hit needs trade/inspection and roof-access review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Kevin hizo un círculo de tiza alrededor de cada golpe.
reader.sourceEnglish: Kevin drew a chalk circle around each hit.
reader.archivedJapanese: ケビンは各衝突痕をチョークの丸で囲みました。
reader.archivedEnglish: Kevin drew a chalk circle around each hit.
reader.reviewNote: Chalk circles distinguish marked observations from a claim decision.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Contamos 12 golpes en este cuadro, y aquí la teja perdió gránulos.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: We counted 12 hits in this square, and here the shingle lost granules.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「この区画では衝突痕を十二個数えました。ここではシングル材の表面粒も失われています。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: We counted 12 hits in this square, and here the shingle lost granules.
reader.reviewNote: Twelve hits and granule loss are scene observations; do not imply an automatic insurance threshold.

reader.sourceSpanish: Ajustador: ¿Cuántos golpes cuenta usted en el lado norte?
reader.sourceEnglish: Adjuster: How many hits do you count on the north side?
reader.archivedJapanese: 査定人「北側では衝突痕をいくつ数えましたか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Adjuster: How many hits do you count on the north side?
reader.reviewNote: North-side count is the adjusters question, not an established finding.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: En el lado norte contamos solo 3, porque el viento venía del oeste.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: On the north side we counted only 3, because the wind was coming from the west.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「北側では三個だけです。風は西から吹いていました。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: On the north side we counted only 3, because the wind was coming from the west.
reader.reviewNote: Wind-direction explanation is the characters inference and needs source fidelity.

reader.sourceSpanish: El ajustador habló rápido y dio varias medidas en pies cuadrados.
reader.sourceEnglish: The adjuster spoke fast and gave several measurements in square feet.
reader.archivedJapanese: 査定人は早口で、平方フィート単位の寸法をいくつか伝えました。
reader.archivedEnglish: The adjuster spoke fast and gave several measurements in square feet.
reader.reviewNote: Square-foot measurements must retain the unit and numerical meaning.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Perdón, ¿me lo puede repetir más despacio?
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Sorry, can you repeat that more slowly?
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「すみません、もう少しゆっくり繰り返していただけますか。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「すみません、もう少しゆっくり繰り返していただけますか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Sorry, can you repeat that more slowly?

reader.sourceSpanish: Ajustador: Claro, el lado oeste mide 1,200 pies cuadrados y el lado norte mide 800.
reader.sourceEnglish: Adjuster: Sure, the west side measures 1,200 square feet and the north side measures 800.
reader.archivedJapanese: 査定人「はい。西側は千二百平方フィート、北側は八百平方フィートです。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Adjuster: Sure, the west side measures 1,200 square feet and the north side measures 800.
reader.reviewNote: The west and north area measurements are 1,200 and 800 square feet, respectively.

reader.sourceSpanish: Ajustador: Según la aseguradora, el lado oeste se cambia completo y el lado norte se repara.
reader.sourceEnglish: Adjuster: According to the insurance company, the west side gets fully replaced and the north side gets repaired.
reader.archivedJapanese: 査定人「保険会社によると、西側は全面交換、北側は補修です。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Adjuster: According to the insurance company, the west side gets fully replaced and the north side gets repaired.
reader.reviewNote: Insurer-stated replacement/repair scope is attributed to the company, not the crew.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: ¿Está de acuerdo con el alcance del trabajo, también en la canaleta?
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Do you agree with the scope of work, including the gutter?
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「雨どいを含む工事範囲に同意しますか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Do you agree with the scope of work, including the gutter?
reader.reviewNote: Scope question includes the gutter; agreement is not a coverage guarantee.

reader.sourceSpanish: Ajustador: Sí, lo voy a anotar en el reporte, y la aseguradora le mandará una copia al dueño.
reader.sourceEnglish: Adjuster: Yes, I'm going to note it in the report, and the insurance company will send a copy to the owner.
reader.archivedJapanese: 査定人「はい。報告書に記載し、保険会社から所有者へ写しを送ります。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Adjuster: Yes, I'm going to note it in the report, and the insurance company will send a copy to the owner.
reader.reviewNote: Adjuster promises report note and insurer copy; preserve who sends the report.

see.label: Identify the hail hits, chalk circles, test square, and dented gutter.

recall.label: Recall adjuster, claim, roof slope, scope of work, and square foot.

hear.label: Distinguish 衝突痕 from へこみ when spoken.

type.label: Type 'We counted 12 hits in this square' in Japanese.

say.label: Walk an adjuster through the storm findings and agree on the scope.

write.label: Write the west and north roof measurements with their source units.

curriculumAdaptationNote: The source records a Tuesday-night hailstorm, a Thursday 10:00 Ortiz-family claim inspection, west-side gutter dents, a 10-by-10-foot test square, twelve marked hits west and three north, granule loss, 1,200 versus 800 square feet, and the insurer's replacement/repair scope including a gutter question. Keep observations, the crew's wind inference, the adjuster's insurer attribution and the report-copy promise distinct. The scene is not a general hail threshold or coverage rule. Roof access, impact marking, terminology, measurements, insurance/contract scope and Japanese register need qualified review before scored text or audio. Five verbs and grammar examples are pinned separately; archived forms and mode labels are conditional evidence. No learner or saved-progress identity is created.
